title: Home Inspection Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Home Condition Inspection: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Home Inspection Estimate Worksheet covers visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern. The home inspection coordinator records Home Condition Inspection observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Home Inspection Estimate Worksheet keeps Home Condition Inspection exceptions visible until the home inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Home Inspection Estimate Worksheet at residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems. Document visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern identity before Home Condition Inspection begins. Compare visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern findings with stated Home Condition Inspection criteria; route unresolved Home Condition Inspection issues to qualified home-condition reviewer. For Home Inspection Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Home Condition Inspection. Ask qualified home-condition reviewer to review Home Condition Inspection conditions beyond the home inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Property estimate review and customer identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

blocks.label: Home Condition Inspection identity

fields.label: Occupancy, weather, utilities, and access status
System age or identifier when visible

blocks.guidance: Use the Home Condition Inspection identifier printed on visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern or its linked source record.

sections.title: Pricing options and customer decision inputs
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Home Condition Inspection scope observations
items: Site drainage, exterior, roof, and visible structure
Interior rooms, windows, doors, stairs, and finishes
Electrical, plumbing, heating, cooling, and installed equipment
Attic, insulation, ventilation, and moisture indication
Visible foundation, crawlspace, basement, and drainage
Limitations, inaccessible areas, and specialist referral triggers
blocks.guidance: Mark what was observed or supplied as estimate input; explain anything material that could not be inspected.

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions
sections.guidance: State what could change the price, timing, method, or scope before the customer or responsible party decides.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when a safety hazard, access limitation, active damage, or required specialist escalation remains uncommunicated. Protect visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern; document the Home Condition Inspection notification and await qualified home-condition reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Conditions that may require a revised estimate or specialist review
items: Active electrical, fuel, structural, or water hazard
Specialist evaluation or immediate protection needed
blocks.guidance: For Home Condition Inspection, identify affected visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern scope; ask home inspection coordinator to document the Home Condition Inspection immediate control before continuing.

sections.title: Estimate decision and selected service scope
sections.guidance: Record the selected option and spending limit. Approval of an estimate authorizes only the stated scope and terms.

blocks.label: Estimate support retained
items: Operating observation and measurement where appropriate
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern; mark only Home Condition Inspection evidence present in that record.
